_comment: Model tiers for offloaded work (scripts/llm.py). VERIFY exact OpenRouter model IDs at openrouter.ai/models before first use - IDs change. Claude Code agents themselves use the 'model:' frontmatter field (haiku/sonnet/opus); this file governs the sidecar pool.

local.use_for: bulk summaries, drafts, classification, PII redaction (Helga: local ONLY)

budget._model_note: Tried in order; falls to the next on error or rate limit. IDs verified on OpenRouter 2026-09-26.
budget.use_for: minimal tasks needing more quality than local: light rewriting, structured extraction, simple Q&A over provided text. NEVER client or personal data (free providers may log prompts).

research._model_note: Tried in order. Sonar Deep Research is slow (can take minutes) and adds Perplexity search charges. IDs verified on OpenRouter 2026-09-26.
research.use_for: mid-price work between free and frontier: long reasoning, market/competitor research needing live web sources (Sonar). No client or personal data.
research.cost: paid, mid-range: Hermes 4 405B $1/$3, Sonar Deep Research $2/$8 per 1M tokens plus search fees

media._comment: Image, voice and avatar video via scripts/media.py (not llm.py). IDs and HeyGen endpoints verified 2026-09-26. Needs HEYGEN_API_KEY in .env for HeyGen jobs.

voice.cost: gpt-audio-mini $0.60/$2.40 per 1M tokens; HeyGen uses HeyGen plan credits

video.cost: HeyGen plan credits per video minute

media.use_for: marketing/media assets: social images, voice-overs, talking-avatar explainers. Human sign-off before anything is published. No client personal data or likenesses without written consent.

frontier._model_note: Tried in order; falls to the next on error. Cheapest first; Fable is the priciest so it is the last resort. IDs verified on OpenRouter 2026-09-26.
frontier.use_for: heavy/strategic offloads: second-opinion reviews, board-grade analysis, gnarly code, high-stakes client copy
frontier.cost: premium per token - set a spend limit in your OpenRouter account

rules: Privacy-sensitive input never leaves tier local (Helga's lane).
Default offload tier is local; step up only when quality visibly fails.
Frontier calls require a one-line justification in the completion note.
Ben's own reasoning and all department agents run on the Claude subscription (per-agent model: frontmatter), not OpenRouter.
